clue.text: What may have volumes written on Eton and Stowe, seemingly?

definitions.text: What may have volumes written on Eton and Stowe, seemingly?

parts.words: What may have volumes written on Eton and Stowe, seemingly?
parts.note: a multi-volume reference work covers everything, and its name comes from the Greek for an all-round education, as if it were a book about famous schools such as Eton and Stowe

explanation.surface: A question about where you might find whole books written on two famous English public schools.
explanation.walkthrough: Eton and Stowe are English fee-paying boarding schools; the word's Greek roots mean 'general education', hence the 'seemingly'.
explanation.definitionFit: A reference work in many volumes covers every subject, the Greek name meaning rounded schooling.

clue.text: Speak fast

definitions.meaning: to put a thought or feeling into words, voice it
describing a train or delivery that is quick and non-stop

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to voice an opinion; as an adjective it describes a quick service or train.

clue.text: Pack instrument for one whose hands are not to be trusted

definitions.text: one whose hands are not to be trusted

parts.note: a pack is a deck of playing cards
a harp is a stringed musical instrument

explanation.surface: A musician's kit sits beside someone with untrustworthy fingers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hands' are dealt hands of cards as well as fingers, which is what makes the definition fair.
explanation.definitionFit: A cheat at cards is a player whose dealing and hands cannot be relied on.

clue.text: Taxi-driver is irritable losing third of fare

indicators.note: losing tells us a letter is dropped from the irritable word

parts.note: crabby means bad-tempered and irritable

indicators.note: third of points to the third letter of the word fare

explanation.surface: A grumpy taxi-driver loses a third of the fare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'third of fare' is not a fraction of money but the third letter of 'fare', R.
explanation.definitionFit: A cabby is a colloquial name for someone who drives a cab for hire.

clue.text: Dungarees — under a hundred they're pretty much the same

indicators.note: under here means short of, so the hundred is taken away

parts.note: coveralls, one-piece work suits, are practically identical garments to dungarees
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: Bib-and-brace trousers at under a hundred pounds look much like the expensive ones.
explanation.walkthrough: The near-synonym COVERALLS, minus C ('under a hundred', i.e. lacking it), leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Dungarees are a kind of protective work trousers with a bib, also called by this plural name.

clue.text: Agreement how a group of notes will sound

indicators.note: will sound signals that the words are said aloud to give a different spelling

parts.note: a chord is a group of notes played together

explanation.surface: A musical question of agreement in how notes will be heard together.
explanation.definitionFit: An agreement between parties is formally called an accord, a synonym.

clue.text: Undid pin in messy diaper which may contain soil

indicators.note: in means one set of letters is placed inside the other
messy means the letters of diaper are jumbled
undid means the pin's letters are taken apart and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone unfastens a safety pin on a soiled nappy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Undid' scrambles PIN into NPI, which goes 'in' DRAIPE, made by 'messy' from DIAPER; diaper is the American word for a nappy. 'soil' is sewage, as in soil pipe.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipe carrying waste water or sewage away may carry soil, sewage, from a building.

clue.text: Theatre backer is a new and upcoming supporter

indicators.note: upcoming in a down clue means the word reads upwards, so backwards

parts.note: a leg supports a table or a body

explanation.surface: A rising young star is said to have found a new financial supporter in the theatre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upcoming' turns LEG into GEL, read up the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: An investor who puts money into a stage production is known in theatre slang as its angel.

clue.text: British above French eleven in third place

indicators.note: above in a down clue puts the first piece over the second

parts.note: onze is the French word for eleven

explanation.surface: A British team beats a French football eleven but only finishes third.
explanation.walkthrough: A bronze medal goes to the one who finishes third, so the definition stands for that position.
explanation.definitionFit: The bronze medal is awarded for third place, so it stands for coming third.

clue.text: Allegory is forgivable when fellow is withdrawn

indicators.note: is withdrawn means the fellow is taken out of the longer word

parts.note: pardonable means able to be forgiven
a don is a university fellow

explanation.surface: An allegorical tale says something can be excused once a man pulls out.
explanation.definitionFit: A parable is a simple story with a moral, a form of allegory.

clue.text: Plate one puts into battery

definitions.meaning: a large flat serving dish or platter
a device that puts power into a rechargeable battery

explanation.definitionFit: A charger is both a large serving dish and a device that replenishes a battery.

clue.text: Try succeeded following English promise

indicators.note: following puts the succeeded letter after the English one

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for succeeded, as in family trees
to say, as in 'I say you'll win', is to assert or pledge

explanation.surface: Someone who succeeded follows up an English promise with another attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: As a noun an essay is an attempt, a synonym for a try.

clue.text: Daniel ran with transforming stimulant

indicators.note: transforming means the letters of the two names are rearranged

explanation.surface: Daniel went for a run and was transformed by a rush of energy.
explanation.definitionFit: A hormone released in stress that stimulates the heart is the body's natural stimulant.

clue.text: Vast expanse's a miserable place for hermit's abode

parts.note: the sea is a vast expanse of water, with its possessive 's
hell is a place of misery

explanation.surface: The ocean seems a wretched place for a recluse to live.
explanation.walkthrough: The hermit is a hermit crab, which lives in a borrowed shell, not a recluse.
explanation.definitionFit: A hermit crab lives inside an empty shell it finds on the shore, so that is its home.

clue.text: American greeting lands chap in trouble

indicators.note: in trouble means the letters are put into disorder

explanation.surface: An American's friendly handshake gets some chap into trouble.
explanation.definitionFit: A handclasp is a handshake, a greeting chiefly so named in American usage.

clue.text: Ring for seats in theatre

definitions.meaning: the curved upper tier of seating in a theatre

explanation.definitionFit: It means a round shape, and also the upper balcony seating in a theatre.

clue.text: Capital feature of bird, one that makes a crow

definitions.text: Capital feature of bird, one that makes a crow

parts.words: Capital feature of bird, one that makes a crow
parts.note: capital means on the head: the fleshy red crest on top of the head of a rooster, the bird whose call is a crow

explanation.surface: A description of a crow's head, as if crow were the bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crow' is the noise a rooster makes, not the black bird; 'Capital' is from Latin caput, head.
explanation.definitionFit: The red crest on a rooster's head is its comb, the feature on top of the bird.

clue.text: Killing made by service area

parts.note: Mass is a church service
an acre is a unit of area

explanation.surface: A murder is committed near a motorway service area.
explanation.definitionFit: A massacre is the brutal slaughter of many people, a large-scale killing.

clue.text: Mountain tree by a lake

parts.note: a pine is a coniferous tree

explanation.surface: A mountain tree grows beside a lake.
explanation.definitionFit: Alpine as an adjective means of high mountains, from the Alps.

clue.text: Problem at home with a rising hostility

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the pieces are read from bottom to top

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem
in means at home

explanation.surface: A domestic problem stirs up growing bad feeling.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' turns the whole run SUM-IN-A upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Animus is ill will or hostility towards someone, a direct synonym.

clue.text: An E-D-C twice could be given rhythm so?

indicators.note: could be signals that the letters may be rearranged into another word
twice means the three letters are used two times

parts.note: the three letters as printed

explanation.surface: A descending three-note musical phrase repeated twice might be rhythmic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'twice' doubles EDC; 'could be' rearranges AN EDCEDC. E, D, C are also notes, which suits the musical definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Cadenced means having a regular rise and fall of sound, so given a rhythm.

clue.text: Cease to function without effective eating area

indicators.note: without here means outside, with one word placed around the other

parts.note: to die is to stop working
nett means final or effective, as in a nett result

explanation.surface: A dining area stops working without being effective.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' looks like 'lacking' but here has its old sense of 'outside'; nett, the British spelling of net, means effective as in final.
explanation.definitionFit: A dinette is a small alcove or area set aside for eating meals.

clue.text: Light-headed, whether from bottle or not

definitions.text: Light-headed, whether from bottle or not

parts.words: Light-headed, whether from bottle or not
parts.note: light-headed reads as having fair hair, whether natural or bleached from a bottle, not tipsy from drinking

explanation.surface: Someone is dizzy, perhaps from drinking or perhaps not.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Light-headed' and 'bottle' suggest drink; it means fair-haired, natural or dyed.
explanation.definitionFit: A person with fair hair has light-coloured locks, whether the colour is natural or dyed.

clue.text: With two sides equal, one's close in play with bridge opponents

parts.note: one is I, the Roman numeral, plus the 's

indicators.note: in play signals the word close is rearranged

parts.note: in bridge East and South belong to different partnerships, so they are opponents

explanation.surface: One player is close to the action in a game of bridge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in play' rearranges CLOSE into OSCEL; the bridge seats are North, South, East, West.
explanation.definitionFit: An isosceles triangle has two sides of equal length.

clue.text: Wilde's letter read out on radio

definitions.meaning: the first name of the Irish writer Wilde
the word for O in the radio phonetic alphabet

explanation.definitionFit: It is Wilde's first name and the radio code word for the letter O.

clue.text: Builder taking issue with master

parts.note: MA is a Master of Arts
a son is issue, offspring

explanation.surface: A builder disputes a point with his boss.
explanation.definitionFit: A mason builds in stone or brick, so is a builder.

clue.text: Customs inspector finding Ecstasy a little earlier

indicators.note: a little earlier means the drug letter is shifted one place forward

parts.note: Inspector Morse is the detective of British television
E is slang for the drug ecstasy

explanation.surface: A customs officer finds ecstasy a little earlier in a search.
explanation.walkthrough: Inspector Morse is a long-running British TV detective series set in Oxford. Moving E one place earlier turns MORSE into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Mores are the customs and conventions of a community, a formal synonym.

clue.text: China upset after United Nations release

indicators.note: after puts the jumbled word behind the abbreviation
upset means the letters are overturned and rearranged

explanation.surface: China is annoyed after the United Nations releases a statement.
explanation.definitionFit: To unchain someone is to free them, a synonym for release.

clue.text: Complain with state beginning to tax vehicle cover

parts.note: to carp is to complain
OR is the abbreviation for Oregon, a US state

indicators.note: beginning to picks out the first letter of the word tax

explanation.surface: Someone grumbles about a state starting to tax cars.
explanation.definitionFit: A carport is an open-sided shelter that covers a parked car.

clue.text: Blameworthy empty revenue, capable of grasping about billion

indicators.note: empty means the inside letters of revenue are removed, keeping its first and last letters
about means the grasping word goes around the billion letter

parts.note: prehensile describes a tail or limb able to grasp

explanation.surface: A government emptying the revenue to grab another billion is to be blamed.
explanation.definitionFit: Reprehensible means deserving rebuke, a synonym for blameworthy.
